The '''Nez Peron system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nez Peron/Legends|Nez Peron]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Nez Peron system was the theater of a [[Battle of Nez Peron|battle]] concluded with a Sith victory.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Nez Peron Sweep}}</ref>
